status: Called in by Secretary of State
description: Replacement of existing timber framed doors/windows with aluminium framed doors/windows, alteration to flat roof balustrade, installation of green roof and associated works.
decision_conditions:
FLAT ROOF NOT USED AS AMENITY SPACE (COMPLIANCE): The use of the flat roof of the building including the green roof hereby approved (as shown on approved drawing 1794/05) shall be as set out in the application and the roof area shall not be used as a balcony, roof terrace or similar amenity area in perpetuity. The roof shall only be accessed for essential maintenance, repair or escape in case of emergency.

REASON: To prevent the undue overlooking of neighbouring habitable room windows and protect neighouring amenity in accordance with Policy PLAN1 of Islington's Strategic and Development Management Policies (2023).
